description: Registered speech voices for an OS release and a locale. The languages key is the application locale the launch named: a single --fingerprint-locale tag, or the first tag of a list. The empty-string key is always present and is what a locale nobody measured, or a launch that named none, projects onto. Only localService true voices appear here. The network voices Chromium lists are served by its network speech synthesis component against a Google endpoint and need build-time keys, so they are a build capability and not a profile value (docs/FINGERPRINTS.md section 8).
